[#january.month,leaf=9,folio-start=7]
== [.mon]#XI Mon.# January hath xxxi days.

image::blank.svg[role=spacer,pdfwidth=1pt,pdfheight=20.36pt]

[.verse-title]
[.i900]##{nbsp}##More nice than wise.

[.verse-line]
[.i263]##{nbsp}##Old Batchelor would have a Wife that’s wise,
[.i261]##{nbsp}##Fair, rich, and young, a Maiden for his Bed;
[.i259]##{nbsp}##Not proud, nor churlish, but of faultless size;
[.i266]##{nbsp}##A Country Houswife in the City bred.
[.i144]##{nbsp}##He’s a nice Fool, and long in vain hath staid;
[.i144]##{nbsp}##He should bespeak her, there’s none ready made.
